investigationQuestion: Which unit at 18 Mason Street is tied to the fraud and the van, and what exact location should police enter?
setting: The police case portal and property directory
startingSituation: The case portal shows CAM-0918-221 at 18 Mason Street. Click “Check property directory,” compare the unit listings with Northline’s address, and verify the entrance notice before reporting a unit.
playerRole: You are Maya Chen’s trusted friend, using the vehicle match and Maya’s fraud records to give police the precise location needed for a safe rescue.
playerCapabilities: Compare tenant, unit, and entrance records.
playerConstraints: Do not attempt entry or contact suspects.
narrativeContext: The directory lists all units, tenants, entrances, and routine neighboring businesses.
Northline leases Unit 3 at the rear loading entrance; the registry and invoice independently tie it to Daniel Price.
Police enter Unit 3 at 09:25 on 2025-09-19, rescue Maya safely, and arrest Daniel Price and Owen Blake.

startingInputs.description: Project-hosted bundle containing CAM-0918-221 and the visible property-directory link.

terminalAction.description: Send police the verified full address in the Location field, including the unit.
